ADD A, #68H
MOV A, #45H
SUBB A, #68H
MOV A, #45H
MOV B, #68H
MUL AB
MOV A, #45H
MOV B, #04H
DIV AB
MOV A, #45H
INC A
MOV A, #45H
DEC A
END

MOV B, #07CH

MOV R3, A
END

files.name: Right_Left_Shift_With_Without_Carry.asm
files.label: 1A.05 Shift Operations (ASM)
files.code:
; (i) Right shift with & without carry
ORG 00H
MOV A, #0ACH
RR A
MOV R0, A
CLR C
MOV A, #0ACH
RRC A
MOV R1, A
SETB C
MOV A, #0ACH
RRC A
MOV R2, A
END

; (ii) Left shift with & without carry
ORG 00H
MOV A, #0ACH
RL A
MOV R0, A
CLR C
MOV A, #0ACH
RLC A
MOV R1, A
SETB C
MOV A, #0ACH
RLC A
MOV R2, A
END

title: Ultrasonic Distance Measurement (Arduino)
desc: Interfacing HC-SR04 Ultrasonic Distance Sensor with Arduino Uno: generating 10us trigger pulse on pin 6, reading echo pulse duration using pulseIn(7, HIGH), computing distance in cm, and logging to Serial Monitor.
hardware: Arduino Uno, HC-SR04 Ultrasonic Sensor (Trig: Pin 6, Echo: Pin 7), Serial Monitor at 9600 Baud
